title: Skills
description: content/data/skills.json: an object. Every key except resume_skills is a homepage Skills category (key -> list of strings); keys are shown title-cased ("programming-languages" -> "Programming Languages") unless config.labels.skillCategories names them.

resume_skills.description: Categories for the resumes and llms.txt: display name -> list of skills. Two special keys configure the resumes.

resume_skills_long_override.description: Full CV only: category -> list that replaces that category's skills.

additionalProperties.description: Skills in this category, shown comma-separated.

resume_skills_short_merge.description: Short resume only: {"From Category": "Into Category"} folds one category into another.

additionalProperties.description: Name of the category to merge into.
